\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{warning} \texttt{halo\_exchange/?} reports 0 messages but the fabric logged 14: the collective's own accounting disagrees with the traffic it produced.
  \item \finding{note} Parallel efficiency is 15.2\%: 84.8\% of the rank-seconds paid for went unused.
  \item \finding{note} Collectives account for 63.6\% of the run's rank-seconds, so more of the pool's time went to coordination than to work.
  \item \finding{ok} 56 rank reattachment(s) occurred, up to incarnation 9: agent processes were replaced mid-run while the rank roles, their mailboxes, and their context accounts persisted.
  \item \finding{ok} All 9 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
\end{itemize}
